title: Commuter backpack product page
context: An online shop sells a 20-litre commuter backpack for city cyclists.

# Commuter backpack 20 L
Price 349 €. Photos: one dark, low-resolution picture. Description: 'Bag. Good.' Material not stated. No size or weight. Shipping: 6-8 weeks. Returns: not accepted. Reviews: 2.1/5 (3 reviews: 'zip broke after a week', 'not waterproof', 'never arrived').

# Commuter backpack 20 L
Price 89 €. Waterproof recycled fabric, padded laptop sleeve (16''), reflective strips, rear light loop. 920 g. Photos on a cyclist, in the rain, and inside the bag. Shipping in 48 h, free returns for 30 days, 2-year warranty. Reviews: 4.6/5 (812 reviews).
